cohort.source_recovery: Common receipt owns full source archive/member verification, all native command/log/trial hashes, failed preparation attempt and terminated resources. Each artifact source.tar.gz recovers the exact source tree.

linked.interpretation_limits: Static symbol instruction counts include cold/unissued paths. Call sites are not dynamic calls/traversal. Tables/payload/function extents are byte-verified against actual measured ELFs. No PMU or causal ablation performed.

observations.fact: Columns select one operation pointer per block, and shared-fresh admits placement using the reusable extent column. Current copied-fresh calls the maintained runtime binder. Its complete linked binder has3820 B / 955 static ARM instructions or4436 B / 953 static x86 instructions; no claim all execute per bind. All routes use the same maintained dense body instantiations.
observations.limit: This compares repeated metadata admission against an already admitted shape, with warm laws/tables and no layout construction/allocation charged.

observations.fact: Fresh and retained shared traversals call the exact same queries<read16,shared_reader> at 0x1a860 (357 B / 84 static instructions), while copied queries are at 0x1a9d0 (342 B / 82). Shared reloads the16-bit selector at 0x1a8b5, then addresses the shared table and calls through it at 0x1a8d0. Copied loads the function pointer directly from the binding at 0x1aa34. The additional selector-dependent memory lookup lies on the indirect-target dependency chain.
observations.limit: Both fresh and retained use that same shared callee, yet retained has ~2% loss and fresh ~22% at q64. The extra lookup alone does not explain the fresh excess. Stack versus resident metadata placement/call context differs; attribution remains unresolved.

observations.fact: Selected k31 Local typed command branches once to native16 at 0x944b2. The qloop keeps decode constants/results in vector registers and consumes values directly, with no per-query native function call. The ordinary dense_read16 at 0x83ae0 writes two ZMM output vectors at 0x83b85/0x83b8b, which indirect callers reread for the checksum.
observations.limit: This is source-identical body reuse with different optimizer visibility, not isolated indirect-call latency or evidence that typed whole commands always win.

observations.fact: Selected k31 Local typed range reloads command.id and rows at 0x60c14/0x60c18 and repeats take/bound/consume setup inside qloop, then directly calls the existing dense_range at 0x60c5c. Columns computes these invariant facts before the qloop (0x133d8..0x13414), then calls the selected same dense_range body at 0x13454.
observations.limit: This is a concrete issued-work difference consistent with retained range losses, not a quantified causal share of every mixed-width timing.

observations.fact: Columns and dispatch both call the same checked attach/bind/initialize wrapper per command; dispatch has76 static call sites across its law branches (3828B ARM or3880B x86), not 76 calls per command. The typed command admits its named view/writer once per block and reuses it across q while preserving fit/capacity checks, journal translation and complete-command memory observation.
observations.limit: Stable destinations are stationary through each command. Accumulated unresolved writes across retarget/generation, preserving mutations and publication are not exercised.
